children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Remove Gameplane without orphaning finalizers, deleting retained worlds, or leaving credentials and cloud resources behind.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: Freeze GitOps and schedules before uninstalling or they may recreate resources while the environment is being decommissioned.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: Inventory platform and game state, classify every item, and obtain owner approval before removal.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: Inventory servers, PVCs, backups, DB, audit, sources, CRDs, and Secrets.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Classify retain, export, migrate, or destroy; verify the final backup.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Stop schedules, webhooks, notifications, and GitOps reconciliation.

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Quiesce writes and remove controllers and dependencies in an order that allows finalizers to complete.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Resolve stuck resources through documented controller workflows.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Decide explicitly about CRDs, namespaces, PVCs, DB, and repositories.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Remove RBAC, webhooks, Services, Ingress, DNS, certs, and load balancers.

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Check for orphaned resources and costs, revoke credentials, and archive restoration and destruction evidence.

children.name: Quick Reference Line 1
children.text: 01  Freeze automation → verify export/backup → approve inventory

children.name: Quick Reference Line 2
children.text: 02  Uninstall controllers before resolving residual finalizers/resources

children.name: Quick Reference Line 3
children.text: 03  Verify no PVC/LB/DNS/Secret/repository remains; archive evidence
